boundary_convention: receipt instant in IST truncated to the minute must lie in [15:10,15:30] (close) or [09:15,09:45] (open), inclusive, on the session date; the slot is scheduling intent only

cases.description: In-window close and open quotes, both indices.
Slot 15:10 (intent) but the response arrived 15:05:02: not in the close window.
Lower close boundary minus 1 ms.
Lower close boundary exactly.
Upper close boundary: last millisecond of minute 15:30.
Final 15:30 poll answered 15:31:00.000 (late); 15:25 in window: close rests on 15:25.
Only the late final poll: no qualifying close.
Lower open boundary exactly.
Lower open boundary minus 1 ms.
Upper open boundary: last millisecond of minute 09:45.
Late final opening poll: slot 09:45 answered 09:46:01.
Next day the ATM CE strike/side appears under a DIFFERENT instrument key (roll); the other five pair.
NF next-day response carries a different expiry for the same keys; BNF normal.
Next day the ATM CE key reports a different strike with a two-sided book; the other five pair.
At 15:30 the ATM CE key reports a different strike (two-sided); 15:10 was clean: close rests on 15:10.
Slot 09:40 received 09:46:00 (late diagnostic) and slot 09:45 received 09:45:01 (eligible): the open is 09:45.
Slot 09:15 received 09:23 and slot 09:20 received 09:21: the EARLIEST eligible receipt (09:20 slot) is the open.
Slot 15:25 received 15:30:30 and slot 15:30 received 15:30:10: the LATEST eligible receipt (15:25 slot) is the close.
Equal receipt instants: the close takes the later slot (15:30), the open the earlier slot (09:15).
Open boundary refused: slot 09:45 received exactly 09:46:00.000.
The close session file is deleted.
The close session file is truncated (unparseable).
The ATM CE 15:30 close observation is removed.
The 15:30 close envelope is removed (all six records lose their receipt).
The ATM CE 15:30 close record is replaced by a one-sided book.
The ATM CE 15:30 close record is replaced by the ATM PE record (another contract).
Close at 15:10 and 15:30; the 15:30 envelope is removed: the marker is corrected to the verifiable 15:10.

selection_rule: receipt_selection_v1_close_latest_open_earliest_eligible_receipt: eligibility first; close = LATEST eligible receipt instant, open = EARLIEST; exact ties: close later slot then larger acquisition_id, open earlier slot then smaller acquisition_id; slot labels are provenance only
verdict_format: per contract PAIR@<close slot>/<open slot> (the slots of the SELECTED observations) or REFUSED:<reason>; per index the distinct verdicts, each with xN when not all six agree, sorted and joined by "; "
